'''Niya Giedan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]. He was a facilitator during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of [[Duros/Legends|Duros]]. He was later employed by [[Pri-Andylan Propulsion Systems]] and was known for keeping projects on schedule through his efficient and militaristic techniques.<ref name="University" />
